purpose: Review a finite catalog of SW2021 L1 industry-relative mechanisms against the source's original one-hypothesis collection contract, its terminal breadth history, and the complete 157-definition library before any membership row, candidate value, comparator value, price or forward return is read for Campaign154.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_sw1_leave_one_out_residual_variance_share_238m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: For each within-half minute return, subtract the synchronous equal-weight leave-one-out mean of point-in-time SW2021 L1 peers and divide residual quadratic variation by own quadratic variation.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: exact 238 within-half returns, SW2021 L1 interval assignment and at least 10 other peers at every position
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The original membership contract authorizes one daily peer-breadth factor and explicitly closes industry price momentum after failure. The residual-variance operator also migrates terminal intraday_market_idiosyncratic_share from the whole market to an exposed group label.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_sw1_neutral_late_residual_drift_30m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Subtract the point-in-time industry's leave-one-out late return from the stock's final-30-minute return.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: fixed final 30 minutes, SW2021 L1 interval assignment and at least 10 other complete peers
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: It is an industry-group substitution inside terminal late return and market-neutral late residual drift, while the original SW contract forbids an industry price-momentum replacement.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_sw1_amount_profile_synchronization_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Correlate the stock's normalized 240-minute amount profile with the synchronous leave-one-out normalized amount profile of its point-in-time SW2021 L1 peers.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: exact 240-minute profiles, SW2021 L1 intervals and at least 10 other complete peers
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The collection contract requested membership only for the one breadth hypothesis and forbids amount fields in that source branch. Grouping the terminal market amount-profile synchronization operator by industry is not a new observation.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_sw1_range_profile_synchronization_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Correlate the stock's normalized high-low range profile with the leave-one-out point-in-time SW2021 L1 peer range profile.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: exact 240-minute range profiles, SW2021 L1 intervals and at least 10 other complete peers
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: It reuses the terminal market range-profile synchronization formula with a post-result industry grouping and adds price/range fields excluded by the original membership source contract.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_sw1_relative_session_amount_rank_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Rank log1p exact-session total CNY amount only among the stock's point-in-time SW2021 L1 peers.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: exact 240 bars, point-in-time L1 peers and deterministic average ranks
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign152's absolute amount magnitude is terminal and cannot be rescued through industry normalization. The membership contract also did not authorize this factor.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: sw1_current_membership_tenure_sessions
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Count accepted local sessions from the active membership interval's in_date through the signal session.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: SW2021 L1 active interval, inclusive in_date and accepted local trading calendar
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Membership tenure would be a different raw state, but in_date/out_date were collected solely to assign the preregistered breadth factor. Turning interval age into a new score after observing the breadth result violates the original one-factor collection contract.

selection.reason: Five proposals are post-result industry group substitutions or combinations inside terminal price, range, amount and residual operators; the only distinct interval-tenure state is outside the source's preregistered one-factor use.

decision.next_campaign_requirement: Use a genuinely new finite prevalue mechanism whose already accepted source was originally collected for that use, or conduct a separately authorized pre-data source-admission campaign.
